observations: Photo 0: A white electric iron lying on its side on a tiled floor.
Body is dusty/stained with dirt marks on the casing.
Cord is a woven fabric-covered cable, dirty and frayed in places.
Near the plug end, the cord insulation looks stripped/exposed, showing bare wire strands twisted together.
A UK-style 3-pin plug is attached to the cord.
Soleplate (ironing surface) is not visible in this photo, only the top/side of the iron is shown.
No brand name, logo, or model number is visible anywhere on the iron body.
not_shown: Condition of the soleplate (scratches, rust, residue, smoothness)
Whether the iron powers on and heats properly
Safety of the exposed/frayed wiring at the plug end
Presence or absence of steam/water function and tank condition if applicable
Any brand or model marking on the underside or back of the iron
Full length and condition of the cord beyond what's shown
